About the Authority

We regulate and develop Qatar's real estate sector so every property decision is clearer and safer.

The Real Estate Regulatory Authority (Aqarat) licenses and oversees development, brokerage, appraisal and property management, publishes market data, and guides investors from studying an idea to managing their property.
